item.title: 1996 Ford Bronco XLT at No Reserve
item.description: This 1996 Ford Bronco XLT is finished in Dark Toreador Red and Silver Frost Metallic over Opal Gray cloth and powered by a 5.0-liter V8 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case. Equipment includes a power-operated tailgate window, 15" forged aluminum wheels, air conditioning, cruise control, power windows, and a Panasonic CD stereo. item.title: 21-Years-Owned 2000 BMW M5 at No Reserve
item.description: This 2000 BMW M5 was purchased in 2004 by the seller, who has since added approximately 66k of the 96k miles. The car is powered by a 4.9-liter V8 paired with a six-speed manual transmission and is finished in Le Mans Blue Metallic over black Nappa Heritage leather upholstery. Equipment includes 18" Style 65 wheels, a limited-slip differential, a sunroof, xenon headlights, fog lights, heated power-adjustable front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, and navigation. item.title: 2020 OTK Kosmic Mercury R 125cc Go-Kart at No Reserve
item.description: This Kosmic Mercury R go-kart was produced by the OTK Kart Group of Prevalle, Italy, and features composite bodywork with red, white, and blue graphics. Power comes from a 125cc Rotax JR Max single with a centrifugal clutch and chain drive. Equipment includes a Nassau panel, a rear disc brake, a Tillett fiberglass seat, a four-spoke steering wheel, an electric starter, an aluminum radiator, yellow race number plates, and a rear bumper. item.description: This 1976 Mercedes-Benz 450SEL is said to have been purchased new by actor and singer Doris Day and kept in California until she sold it in 2008.
